title: Disneyland Halloween 2001 Minnie Mouse Plush Beanie Bean Bag Witch Disney
descriptionText: The product is a Disneyland Halloween 2001 Minnie Mouse plush beanie bean bag, featuring the beloved Disney character in a whimsical witch-themed design. This collectible item, originating from China, is part of the Disney franchise and is a must-have for fans of Disneyana and contemporary plush toys. With its unique theme and limited release year, this Minnie Mouse plush beanie is a special addition to any Disney collection.
